verdict.rationale: Featurebase docs mention segmenting by user attributes and using AI to surface impactful feedback, which hints at contextual prioritization, but there is no concrete evidence of a feature that displays customer attributes (e.g., revenue, plan, company) directly alongside individual feedback items for prioritization. missing for 10: explicit customer profile/CRM data shown next to feedback posts, evidence of segment filters within the feedback prioritization view, and independent confirmation of this workflow.
